subject: Embedding merge reconciliation and backward-compatibility test plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>, Jake Turner <jake.turner@brightmart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Embedding merge reconciliation and backward-compatibility test plan

Hi Elena / Jake,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we discussed, BrightMart's current production index includes two parallel embedding generations (v1 legacy and v2 new encoder) and you want a non-disruptive merge so search+rerank behavior remains stable post-backfill.

Attached is a proposed plan that focuses on: 1) deterministic ID reconciliation, 2) verifying score parity risk windows for reranker inputs, and 3) a small staged backfill with acceptance gates. Key asks from BrightMart: a list of failing queries that change ranking, and a compact smoke dataset we can use to certify the cutover.

High-level timeline (attached doc + CSV):
- Jan 19: small parallel backfill (10k docs) into a staging index (read-only for prod traffic mirroring)
- Jan 20: rerank smoke tests comparing top-20 for the smoke queries, automated diffs + human review
- Jan 21: reconciliation check (ID collisions, metadata drift) and rollback window evaluation
- Jan 25: full backfill kickoff pending acceptance

Please confirm:
- which 200 smoke queries you want us to run (we've suggested a seed set in the Drive folder)
- whether your vector DB vendor (VectorDB Ltd) will allow concurrent read snapshots for our staging index
- any contract constraints on the SOW change (we've cc'd Marissa and Ben for procurement and SOW updates).

Attachments: backfill_manifest.csv (sample doc ids + timestamps), rerank-smoke-sample.jsonl (proposed query set).

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123
From: Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Turner <jake.turner@brightmart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Embedding merge reconciliation and backward-compatibility test plan

Kimberly,

Thanks — this looks close to what we need. Quick answers:
- We'll share the 200-candidate smoke queries by EOD (sending Jake's export shortly).
- VectorDB (we use VectorDB Ltd) supports snapshot reads but they require a short maintenance window to create a consistent snapshot; they've asked for the request by Jan 20. I've looped in support.
- Contract: SOW v2 is fine but our procurement wants the rollback clause specified (we need explicit data-retention and revert steps in the SOW).

Two asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a deterministic diff of reranker scores (CSV) so we can plug into our QA dashboard?
2) For the staging backfill, what are the exact resource and timing expectations? We need to line up our infra people.

I'll upload the smoke query set in ~2 hours.

—Elena
Elena Park
Head of Search, BrightMart
From: VectorDB Support <support@vectordb.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Snapshot reads for staging backfill

Hi all,

We can provide a consistent snapshot for the staging backfill. Details:
- Snapshot creation: 15–30 min depending on index size.
- Read throughput: snapshots are read-only; you can run parallel ingestion into a separate namespace while reads continue.
- Limits: max concurrent snapshot ops per account = 2; if you need more, we can schedule a short elevated window.

We'll need a JIRA ticket with the requested snapshot time and the index name. If you provide the index name we will provision the snapshot window on Jan 19 or Jan 20.

Regards,
VectorDB Support
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>, VectorDB Support <support@vectordb.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Embedding merge reconciliation and backward-compatibility test plan

Folks — looping in the implementation/offboarding steps and giving estimated resource needs.

Implementation notes:
- Staging index name: brightmart_staging_snapshot_20270119 (please confirm with VectorDB).
- We will run a 10k doc backfill (~2 hrs ingest time) using Redwood Dedicated worker pool (2 x A100 equivalent) unless BrightMart requests lower resource. Estimated cost note included in SOW.
- Output artifacts: rerank_diff.csv (query_id, doc_id, score_v1, score_v2, delta, significant_flag), sample_rank_lists.jsonl (top-20 per query).
- Acceptance criteria for greenlight: <=5% of queries show a significant rank change (significant = MRR drop > 0.03 and human reviewer flags relevance regression).

Operational checklist:
- [ ] BrightMart to confirm snapshot time and provide 200 queries (Jake).
- [ ] VectorDB to create snapshot (support).
- [ ] Redwood to run backfill into staging and produce rerank_diff.csv (Marissa/Ben).
- [ ] BrightMart to run human review on 200 queries and accept/reject.

Attachments to SOW: BrightMart_SOW_v2.pdf (includes rollback language and data retention timeline).

Marissa
Director, Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Embedding merge reconciliation and backward-compatibility test plan

Quick status update after morning run:

- We completed the 10k staging backfill at 09:40 PT. Ingest time ~1h45m (2 x A100 pool).
- rerank_diff.csv generated and uploaded to the Drive folder. Quick numbers: 12 of 200 queries flagged by automated threshold (6%). Team triaged 50 of the samples — 8 of those showed clear relevance regression (we flagged for human review).
- Next steps: schedule a 60-min review with BrightMart's search SMEs tomorrow 09:30 PT to triage the 12 queries.

If BrightMart signs off on manual triage outcomes (expecting 2–3 regressions to be resolved via prompt/feature engineering), we'll propose proceeding with full backfill on Jan 25. If regressions exceed acceptance criteria we'll pause and run a rollback plan (outlined in SOW).

Attachments: rerank-smoke-sample.jsonl (queries used), rerank_diff.csv (results).

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
